title: Entitled Judge Thinks Laws Don’t Apply To Her
description:
This county judge’s abhorrent, entitled behavior was enough to end her career in one night. The officer proceeded to take her to the jail for fingerprinting but unsurprisingly she still refused to comply. She could’ve been easily released after identifying herself but she’s made the decision to spend the night in the patrol car. The female was later identified as 38 year old Christina, a Douglas County Judge. She was charged with simple battery against a police officer and obstruction of a law enforcement officer. After the incident, The Georgia Supreme Court ruled that she should be removed from the bench. Additionally, she will not be eligible to be elected or appointed to any judicial office in Georgia for the next 7 years.
